subject: Procura billing constraints: PO metadata mapping and conditional discount pathways
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@procura.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@procura.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: PO field and billing constraints for upcoming agreement

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the demo last week — Procurement here is spinning up the PO and we have a couple of non-standard requirements I need to confirm before we issue. Can you please confirm the following so I can map it to our internal template?

1) PO reference mapping: we need a stable PO reference returned on every invoice as: "Procura-PO-ID" (single header and invoice line field). Is that a straight pass-through or do you require a different key name?

2) Invoice cadence: our default is weekly statements grouped by PO (one invoice per PO per week). Is Redwood able to generate weekly invoices grouped by PO, or do you require consolidated monthly billing?

3) Net terms: Procurement prefers Net60. Is Net60 acceptable for the initial 12-month term, or do you require credit/financial review? If so, what information do you need from us to expedite that?

4) Split POs per business unit: we will issue multiple POs (one per BU) under the same MSA. Can Redwood accept multiple POs tied to a single account and produce separate invoices per PO?

5) VAT / tax evidence: for our AP team we need vendor VAT registration and a billing entity tax ID on the invoice.

Attached is our PO_spec_sheet_v3 for reference (fields highlighted). We have a procurement cutoff on 08/31 and would prefer to finalize accepted billing mechanics by EOW next week if possible.

Thanks,
Elena

Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO field and billing constraints for upcoming agreement

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear checklist. Short answers up-front, then a recommended path.

1) PO reference mapping: we can populate an invoice header called "Procura-PO-ID" exactly as you request and include the same value on each invoice line. We will also carry that value through to our AR metadata so your ERP can match automatically.

2) Invoice cadence: by default our Finance team issues consolidated monthly invoices, but we support weekly per-PO invoices as an exception. Weekly per-PO requires a mapping flag on the PO (see item 4) and a small operational setup step on our side (automated routing). There is no technical limitation.

3) Net terms: Net60 is acceptable but conditional. For Net60 we require a short credit verification and the PO to include the billing entity's legal name + tax ID. For new accounts the quickest path is: (a) signed SOW (b) PO with Billing Entity ID and sample bank remittance details (c) agreed A/R contact. Once we have those, Finance will provision Net60 for the specified PO numbers.

4) Multiple POs: yes — we accept multiple POs mapped to one master account. To ensure separate invoices per PO, include the flag "invoice_per_po=true" in the PO metadata or in the PO header when you send it. If that flag is not present we'll default to consolidated billing per your master account.

5) VAT/tax: we can include Vendor VAT and Billing Entity Tax ID on the invoice PDF and in the machine-readable metadata (invoice XML). Please attach a W-9 or VAT registration certificate when you submit POs.

Action I recommend: please fill our PO mapping template (attached) with two sample PO numbers and the invoice_per_po flag. I will route to Vanessa (cc) for finance exception to enable weekly invoicing and to Karthik (cc) for the PO ingestion mapping. With that we should be able to agree to Net60 for the first term.

I'll also attach a draft SOW so you have the formal doc for Procurement.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Lead | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 206-555-0777

Grace — thanks, that helps. A couple of clarifications and one ask:

• We will send three POs initially (PO: PRC-90021, PRC-90022, PRC-90023) — each should be invoiced separately. We will include invoice_per_po=true.
• Can Redwood support an early-pay discount (2% if paid within 15 days) on a per-PO basis? Our FP&A often asks for incentives like that and I wanted to surface it now.
• For the Net60 credit verification: what specific docs do you need? Can we expedite by providing our last two quarters of revenue and a contact at our bank?

We attached our PO spec (same as before) — please confirm the PO header name exactly to avoid mapping errors. Procurement deadline is 08/31; if we can lock terms this week that would help our ops team.

Thanks,
Elena

> Grace — thanks, that helps. A couple of clarifications and one ask:
> • We will send three POs initially (PO: PRC-90021, PRC-90022, PRC-90023) — each should be invoiced separately. We will include invoice_per_po=true.
> • Can Redwood support an early-pay discount (2% if paid within 15 days) on a per-PO basis?
> • For the Net60 credit verification: what specific docs do you need?

Responses and plan:
1) Early-pay discount: Finance (Vanessa, cc) can approve a standard early-pay program. We support per-PO early-pay discounts; for procurement to get a 2% term we will need this in both PO language and SOW as an optional payment term. Vanessa, can we scope a 2%/15-day option for Procura under deal PROC-2026-0194?

2) Credit verification: Karthik (cc) — for Net60 we need (a) billing entity legal name, (b) tax ID, (c) AP remittance email/phone, and (d) either two quarters of financials or a bank reference. If you can provide these by EOD Friday we can start the provisioning flow. Karthik: I will hand off the PO mapping template once Elena populates it.

3) Operational timeline: proposed mutual action plan:
  - Today: Procura populates the PO-mapping template with PRC-90021..90023 + invoice_per_po flag + VAT/tax IDs (Elena)
  - Thu 08/06: Redwood Finance confirms early-pay option and finalizes Net60 provisioning checklist (Vanessa/Karthik)
  - Fri 08/07: Signed SOW and first PO(s) received — Finance begins credit verification and samples are ingested into our PO pipeline
  - Week of 08/10: Weekly invoices (if requested) start for PRC-90021..90023, otherwise consolidated billing on 08/31

If that timeline works I will send a short doc capture of the MAP and a DocuSign SOW link.

Elena — appreciate the urgency. If you hit any internal gating I can escalate to our Finance Director, but this plan should keep things moving.

Best,
